people.name: Jesus
people.line: The Son of God and Savior of the world.

translations.web: Jesus said to them, “Take heed and beware of the yeast of the Pharisees and Sadducees.”
translations.bsb: “Watch out!” Jesus told them. “Beware of the leaven of the Pharisees and Sadducees.”
translations.kjv: Then Jesus said unto them, Take heed and beware of the leaven of the Pharisees and of the Sadducees.
translations.asv: And Jesus said unto them, Take heed and beware of the leaven of the Pharisees and Sadducees.
